purpose: Test whether one additional bounded concurrent speculative overlap per request can recover enough of V158's QPR gain while retaining V163's throughput-producing lifetime cap and exact placement router.

paper_sequence_gate.homogeneous_middle_and_high_historical_b: retain unchanged and do not rerun

frozen_evidence.v158_interpretation: broad short-work overlap passed QPR means but failed throughput pairing

v165_result_blind_mechanism.interpretation: requiring outstanding zero made the second credit operationally negligible; performance was not revealed

single_mechanism_change_from_v163.credit: increase the hard cumulative speculative admission cap from one to two per request
single_mechanism_change_from_v163.second_credit_guard: the second credit is available only after the first is consumed, the second is unused, and current outstanding incomplete-parent nonterminal speculation is at most one
single_mechanism_change_from_v163.same_window_guard: at most one credit candidate per request is admitted in a scheduling window
single_mechanism_change_from_v163.selection_order: maximum immutable critical-path rank then minimum function ID
unchanged: first V163 credit eligibility and consumption point after successful command send
SRPT request order and critical-path rank definition
V163 Hiku2/OCS placement router and all player scores
NSESche solver, welfare, pricing and feasibility
common HPA, tapes, metrics and policy-independent references

dual_lifetime_credit_definition.first_credit: exact V163 eligibility and deterministic candidate
dual_lifetime_credit_definition.second_credit: same eligibility and deterministic candidate, additionally requiring the first credit consumed, the second unused, and current outstanding incomplete-parent nonterminal speculation at most one
dual_lifetime_credit_definition.consumption: only after the actual scheduling command batch is successfully sent
dual_lifetime_credit_definition.request_retirement: both credit states are forgotten only after the request leaves the live request map
forbidden_inputs: fitted function IDs, node IDs, time cutoffs or admission counts

checks: exact E09, E18 and E20 product/order with no additional seed or baseline
valid QC, ledger, archive inventory, runtime identity and offline reference pairing
V163 frontier thresholds request ordering and placement scores remain unchanged except the sealed dual-credit frontier name
at least one first credit and at least one second dual credit are successfully consumed
every second credit has first-credit state and current outstanding speculation at most one before admission
cumulative admissions never exceed two per request and projected outstanding speculation never exceeds two
at most one lifetime-credit player per request is selected in any window
credit counters conserve across live-request retention and successful command sends
the second-credit blocked-by-outstanding path is exercised
both below-8 and at-or-above-8 routes occur
zero performance or aggregate outcome fields are parsed before audit sealing
result_blind_audit.cap_exhausted_rejection_is_not_a_breadth: the lifetime cap is verified directly by first/second state conservation, zero repeat-admission violations, the cumulative cap and production unit tests; its outcome-independent rejection path need not happen in three seeds

diagnostic_selection_rule.evaluation: Replace only V155 E09, E18 and E20 with V166 and recompute the unchanged complete E01-E20 gates.
diagnostic_selection_rule.throughput_paired_gate: at least 12 of 20 wins, including at least 2 of 3 diagnostic wins
diagnostic_selection_rule.qpr_mean_gate: both QPR conventions strictly greater than OCS 0.055577160345697
diagnostic_selection_rule.qpr_paired_gate: at least 12 of 20 wins with 20 of 20 finite-only values
diagnostic_selection_rule.joint_diagnostic_pass: every listed gate passes without editing this plan
diagnostic_selection_rule.failure: retain all three valid V166 diagnostics, retire V166 and do not run its other seventeen seeds
diagnostic_selection_rule.success: authorize a separately committed remaining-seventeen V166 training plan reusing these three rows
